name: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

aliases: what is bruised pride and lion hides
what are the lion hides for
faq.answer: The lion hides are gathered for a wounded huntsman or trader who supplies raw materials to a local tanner. In exchange for the hides, the quest giver receives finished leather goods essential for their livelihood.

The quest giver suffered an injury and cannot hunt the lions themselves. Rather than breaking a long-standing business agreement with a local tanner, they rely on adventurers to fulfill their delivery.
faq.q: Why does the quest giver need help gathering hides?

faq.answer: The raw hides are traded to a local tanner. The tanner processes them into finished leather goods that the quest giver requires for their regular trade and work.

aliases: why is it called bruised pride
faq.answer: The title plays on both words: a literal pride of lions that must be hunted, and the injured hunter's personal pride, having never failed to deliver on a contract despite their current physical limitations.
faq.q: What does the name 'Bruised Pride and Lion Hides' mean?

faq.answer: No, the agreement remains intact. The delivery of quality lion hides ensures the quest giver upholds their end of the bargain without coming up short.
faq.q: Was the arrangement with the tanner at risk?

faq.answer: The quest giver sustained an injury that prevents them from hunting lions in the wild, though the exact cause of the injury is not detailed. Delivering the hides allows them to preserve their reputation.
faq.q: How was the quest giver injured?

sections.body: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides involves assisting an injured hunter who is unable to track wild beasts due to recent physical harm. To avoid failing an ongoing trade agreement with a neighborhood craftsman, they hire an adventurer to track down wild lions and collect their pelts.
sections.title: A Hunter's Dilemma

sections.body: The collected raw hides are exchanged with a local tanner for finished leather equipment necessary for the quest giver's livelihood. Despite being wounded and having their pride stung by needing outside assistance, upholding the bargain ensures their professional reputation remains unbroken.
sections.title: Honoring the Arrangement

summary: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides is a task to assist an injured hunter or tradesperson who needs raw lion pelts to satisfy a trade agreement with a local tanner. Unable to hunt safely due to their wounds, they rely on traveling adventurers to deliver the materials and preserve their pristine professional record.
